scope: Adopted coarse lower bound on the genuine sum of two rational chart integrals.
unclosed_inputs: Physical-domain integral change of variables, coverage and boundary treatment remain separate; the pullback identity alone is pointwise algebra.
Identification with the actual ordinary-sieve density, actual old-tree construction and the same arithmetic rho is not supplied.
Rough-cutoff tail, strict finite buffers and limit order remain inputs to P4-A/P4-B.
The coarse and fine-grid bounds estimate the same quantity and must not be added. No full K or hUpper supplier is claimed.
scope_of_replay: Stock checker replays each listed production module over its imports; no --fresh full-import-closure replay is claimed.
scope_of_audit: Every declaration owned by listed defining modules, including private/generated declarations; audit source compilation is not audit-source kernel replay.
compile_method: Original pinned Lake invokes official Lean.Elab.runFrontend with trustLevel=0 and warningAsError=true; not a stock-CLI aggregate lake build.
